name: Qdrant Edge
desc: Vector search engine built to run on embedded and edge devices.
desc_zh: 面向嵌入式与边缘设备运行的向量搜索引擎。
solves: A device that must answer without a network cannot call a hosted vector service; the index runs on the device itself.
solves_zh: 必须在无网环境下应答的设备没法调用托管向量服务；索引就在设备本地运行。
best_for: Your robot or kiosk needs similarity search with no internet connection.
best_for_zh: 你的机器人或自助终端需要在没有网络时做相似度搜索。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — qdrant.tech/blog and product navigation）。 Blog post dated July 29, 2025. Not in the ledger, so rule (b).
